extensionDescription.message: Connect this browser profile to a local Tobkiri bridge.

optionsLede.message: Configure the local Tobkiri bridge used by this browser profile.

privacyNote.message: The pairing token stays in this browser profile. Connection checks send browser/profile metadata to the selected local bridge; page content is sent only for an approved companion command.

diagnosticsCopied.message: Safe diagnostics copied. Tokens, page content, and raw errors were excluded.

detailIdle.message: No connection check has run yet.

detailLoading.message: Loading saved settings and connection state.

detailDirty.message: Save these settings before verifying the connection.

detailSaving.message: Saving settings in this browser profile.

detailSavedUnverified.message: Settings were saved locally. Verify the connection separately.

detailConnecting.message: Checking the selected local bridge now.

detailConnected.message: The selected bridge accepted the latest connection check.

detailOffline.message: The bridge could not be reached. Check the local service and network, then retry.

detailUnauthorized.message: The pairing token was rejected or expired. Re-pair with Tobkiri.

detailPermissionBlocked.message: A required browser permission is unavailable. Review extension permissions.

detailNotConfigured.message: Add a local server URL and pairing token, then save settings.

detailError.message: The operation did not complete. Your entered settings were preserved; retry when ready.
